rules.gradients: Forbidden. Use solid colors with 1px borders.
rules.hover_states: Must explicitly set text color on hover. Increase contrast on focus.

layout.spacing: Dense and compact. Use p-4, p-6. gap-4, gap-6.
layout.radius: Minimal. max rounded-md (6px) or rounded-sm (4px) for cards and inputs.
layout.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use grid borders for data-heavy sections (tables, lists).
layout.navigation: Sidebar on desktop, mobile drawer. Fixed top bar for breadcrumbs/actions with glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-md).
layout.alignment: Left-align forms, data, and tables. Center-align empty states.

components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow. On hover: slight lift (-translate-y-px) and border darkens.
components.tables: Dense. Use mono font for IDs, IPs, and timestamps. Sticky header.
components.forms: Shadcn UI. Left aligned. Use concise labels.
components.badges: Transparent background, 1px solid border matching the status color, tinted text.
components.dns_records: Render in code blocks with 1px border. MUST have one-click 'Copy' button. Use mono font.
components.test_email: Modal dialog with 'To', 'Subject', 'Body' and 'Provider/Relay' select dropdown.

motion.feedback: Use Sonner for toast notifications on success/error (e.g., copied to clipboard, email sent).

login_background_light.description: Abstract white and black striped textile, to be used with 20% opacity as a side panel in login/register page.

login_background_dark.description: Abstract monochrome wall, to be used with 20% opacity as a side panel in login/register page.

accessibility.contrast: APCA/WCAG AA compliant. Minimum 4.5:1 for standard text.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='copy-dns-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a robust sidebar navigation (Domains, Mailboxes, Aliases, Delivery Logs, Relays, Settings).
Implement light/dark mode toggle in the top nav or bottom of the sidebar.
For the Domains page, prioritize a clear view of DNS configuration (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX) with verification status badges.
Use JetBrains Mono for all code-like strings (DNS records, logs, config).
Use Shadcn UI extensively (Tables, Badges, Tabs, Dialogs, Select, Dropdowns).
Ensure the UI looks like a highly technical, precise developer tool (e.g., Vercel, Resend).
